text: The goal is to qualify controller version 2.6. Use speed 0.80 m/s, PWM period 2.50 ms, maximum load 4.00 kg, and ambient temperature from 18.0 to 28.0 degrees C. For motor serial M17, reduce the maximum load to 2.75 kg only when the ambient temperature is more than 26.0 degrees C. At exactly 26.0 degrees C, the 4.00 kg limit applies. The timing acceptance limit is a 99th percentile of 3.00 ms. An early note says that version 2.5 passed the timing test. This result does not qualify version 2.6. The qualification status of version 2.6 is unknown.
